context: Ren and Mei reminisce about a close call on a trip.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (一瞬/幸い/気味/そうそう/寄せ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの旅で、一瞬迷子になったよね。
lines.en: On that trip, we got lost for a moment.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle amused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうそう、地図を逆に見てたんだ。
lines.en: Oh right, I was reading the map backwards.
lines.style: rueful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 幸い、親切な人に道を聞けたね。
lines.en: Fortunately, we could ask a kind person.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 少し疲れ気味だったから、焦ったよ。
lines.en: I was a bit tired, so I got flustered.
lines.style: honest young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 車を、道の端に寄せて休んだね。
lines.en: We pulled the car to the roadside and rested.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうそう、あの休憩で助かった。
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 一瞬の判断が、大事だったね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 幸い、いい思い出になったよ。
lines.en: Fortunately, it became a good memory.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
